I am an old man of 80 years, farming these beans with my family as I have done for many seasons. In our North East here in the Sudan Savanna, the rains are short and the soil is tired, but beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they feed themselves from the air. I will use some small NPK to help them start, and the manure from our animals as we always do, but I cannot afford pesticide or irrigation, and at my age I must rely on my children and grandchildren for the hard work.
